gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has chunky, crayon-thick lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave a big gap. And Conthrax, a geometric display face, has no calligraphic modulation at all, so a slightly larger size for the plain sans body would help it hold its own.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Conthrax looks like smooth tubing bent into letters, with a wide-mouthed a and lowercase that nearly catches up to the capitals. Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of its line height and keeps its terminals open, which is the quiet quality that makes the pair hang together.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-hk: Sleek, stiff and unmodulated, Conthrax draws every stroke the same from stem to terminal. And Noto Sans HK follows with large lowercase forms and brush ends that lift away before the curve closes, so a long page feels loose and easy to move through.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-jp: Conthrax builds its capitals from lines of one constant thickness, giving a wide, geometric look with a clean, mechanical edge. But Noto Sans JP has such a large x-height and sweeping open curves that nudging its size down a notch would suit the sans-serif body.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki reads with generous exits that let light through and a big, clear eye on every e. And Conthrax, with its pipe-cleaner letterforms and wide-mouthed a, gives a longer passage a steady, thread-like pull in front of it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Conthrax looks drawn with a single pen tip, every letter an even tube. Noto Sans Lepcha brings curves with a wide opening and a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, and that sturdy, open sans body is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Conthrax has thin joins that are no thinner than its stems. Noto Sans Limbu then lets its gaping curves and big-bodied small letters carry a longer passage, so the sans-serif text feels spacious against that rigid, single-thread heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Conthrax looks traced with a marker, wide and unwavering. Noto Sans Mahajani stands its lowercase up close to the capitals and opens the e like a funnel, which gives the sans-serif text a distinct strength next to that heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Noto Sans Malayalam reads with a middle zone that dominates the line, plus an s whose bends open generously. Conthrax sits in front with no pressure swells where the eye slows down, so a longer passage runs along smoothly beneath it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Neutral in temperament, Noto Sans Mandaic lifts its lowercase close to the capitals and lets its curvy letters feel unclamped. And Conthrax, with zero thick and thin contrast, hands over to it so a longer passage reads in a steady, even flow.
